speaker: Henry B. Eyring
role: First Counselor in the First Presidency
title: “Fear Not, I Am with Thee”
summary: President Eyring teaches that the Lord's promise in the hymn "How Firm a Foundation", "Fear not, I am with thee", is true, though it does not promise to take our trials away, because life is a test we need in order to grow. He tells of his mother, who taught him as a boy that life is supposed to be hard, kept a picture of the Savior on her wall through her last days, and was cared for by his father, and he uses this to show that the Lord keeps His promises through other people. He thanks members who pray to know whom to help, encourage missionaries, support Church leaders and comfort those in need, and he asks others to join them in helping the Lord keep His promise.
